hypotheses.D1_oracle256_reproduces_mlp3_effect: Per-example oracle top-256 channels reach at least 0.50 median downstream fidelity to the full MLP3-only patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.D2_pair_channels_transfer: FineWeb-context-1 pair-frozen top-256 channels reach at least 0.15 median downstream fidelity on held-out context 0 in both corpora.
hypotheses.D3_pair_beats_random: Pair-frozen downstream fidelity exceeds the fixed random-256 control by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.D4_family_beats_random: Family-frozen downstream fidelity exceeds the fixed random-256 control by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.D5_family_is_semantically_specific: Correct-family downstream fidelity exceeds the cyclic wrong-family control by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.D6_family_beats_global: Family-frozen downstream fidelity exceeds a global top-256 channel set by at least 0.03 on both corpora.
hypotheses.D7_family_transfers_ood: TinyStories family-frozen downstream fidelity retains at least 75% of FineWeb fidelity.
hypotheses.D8_frozen_support_is_nonrandom: Pair- and family-frozen top-256 overlap with each query oracle exceeds random overlap by at least 0.03 Jaccard on both corpora.
